President Donald Trump’s approval rating is now underwater in every major swing state as the 2026 midterm elections approach, according to a new analysis released today by Newsweek. The data, based on Civiqs’ rolling tracking poll and measured on August 31, 2026, shows Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term in January 2025. Jennifer Lindahl Bonnie Bolden Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Montgomery Advertiser

Updated Sept. 3, 2026, 1:50 p.m. CT

President Donald Trump’s approval rating among Alabama voters has slipped in recent weeks, according to the latest Civiqs polling, even as he continues to hold a positive overall rating in the state.
